releaseStatus.label: Pre-release alpha
releaseStatus.heading: Thanks for trying Herd
releaseStatus.body: You’re using Herd’s pre-release alpha. Right now, we’re focused entirely on testing functionality. The visual design hasn’t started yet. If you have feedback, please send it to jwoodbury11@gmail.com.

welcome.title: Make plans happen.
welcome.body: Unlock more fun events with completely confidential conditional replies.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.phoneImmutableMessage: Your account phone number cannot be changed.
profile.syncNote: Your phone number and address are never shown to other guests.

unsavedChanges.title: Discard changes?
unsavedChanges.body: Your changes haven’t been saved. If you leave now, they’ll be lost.

logout.title: Log out of Herd?
logout.body: You’ll need to confirm your phone number again to access your invitations.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your Herd account?
accountDeletion.body: This permanently deletes your profile, hosted events, sessions, and private replies. Your place in another host’s event remains only as an anonymous placeholder.
accountDeletion.verificationBody: Enter the four-digit code we sent to your phone. This proves it’s you before the account is deleted.

sending.title: Sending invitations
sending.body: Herd is still sending one or more invitations.

deliveryIssue.title: Invitation delivery issue
deliveryIssue.body: One or more invitations could not be confirmed as delivered. Review the guest list for details.

takingLonger.title: Result taking longer
takingLonger.body: Herd is retrying the event result. Herd will only show the event as confirmed after producing a verified confirmation.

resultUnavailable.title: Result unavailable
resultUnavailable.body: Herd could not safely verify this event’s result and will not show it as confirmed.

legacyResultUnavailable.title: Result unavailable
legacyResultUnavailable.body: This older event was sent before private response evaluation was enabled, so Herd cannot safely verify its result. Create a new event to use private evaluation.

privacyCallout.title: Herd is thoughtfully designed to remove all downsides of answering honestly.
privacyCallout.body: Your conditions are hidden from hosts and guests and stored without your identity.

eventActions.deletionBody: This permanently deletes the event for you and everyone invited. This can’t be undone.
eventActions.failureBody: The event couldn’t be deleted. Please try again.

resolution.pendingBody: The event result updates whenever a reply changes. Individual conditions are never shown to anyone.

resolution.notConfirmedBody: The private conditions did not resolve to a group. No individual replies are revealed.

invitation.unavailableBody: Refresh your events and try again.

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.statusDisclosure: Each guest’s decision to attend stays private until the event is confirmed.
attendees.responseProgressLocked: Reply privately to see who has responded.
attendees.responseProgressVisible: You can see who has already responded.
attendees.emptyMessage: The host hasn’t shared the guest list.

addGuests.title: Add guests
addGuests.body: Enter each guest’s name and phone number. New guests will receive an invitation. If replies have started, the private guest list will reset and everyone who replied will be asked to reply again.
addGuests.failureBody: The attendees couldn’t be added. Please try again.

reply.cantCommitBody: No downside. Honesty is valued. Change it anytime.
reply.addCondition: and this person (or this person) goes
reply.conditionHelp: Each row is required. People joined by OR are alternatives within that requirement. Your conditions are never shown to hosts, guests, or third parties.

reply.conditionPickerEmpty: Everyone available is already part of a condition.

reply.confirmedPreviewBody: Your attendance conditions are never shown to anyone.

reply.notConfirmedPreviewLabel: If the event is not confirmed:

reply.savedTitle: Your private reply has been sent

privacy.title: How privacy works
privacy.intro: Your conditions are evaluated using a private, event-specific ballot ID—not your name, phone number, account, or other identifying information. They’re never shown to hosts, guests, or third parties.
privacy.flowTitle: From your reply to the event result
privacy.flowPrivacyLabel: Your minimum and required-person conditions are never shown to the host or guests.

flowSteps.title: You choose your conditions
flowSteps.body: You can review your private reply whenever you are signed in.

flowSteps.title: Your reply gets a private ballot ID
flowSteps.body: The ballot ID is specific to this event and does not contain your account or contact information.

flowSteps.title: Conditions stay separate from identity
flowSteps.body: Hosts, guests, and third parties never receive your private conditions.

flowSteps.title: The event gets one result
flowSteps.body: The group rules determine whether the event is confirmed and who is attending.

sections.title: How is my reply kept private?
paragraphs: On Herd’s servers, your response is anonymized under a private, event-specific ballot ID and is not personally linked to your name, phone number, or account.
Your conditions are never shown to hosts or guests.

sections.title: Can I see my reply on another device?
paragraphs: Yes. Once you sign in to your account, you can view and update your private reply from any supported device until the event is confirmed or replies close.

sections.title: What can other people see?
paragraphs: Before confirmation, guests who have replied can see who else has responded, but not what anyone chose.
After confirmation, people can see the event result and attendance. Your minimum and required-person conditions remain private.

success.replyPreviewTitle: This is how your reply will appear to others.
success.changeWithoutDeadline: You can change your reply at any time.
